title: Casio ‘CasioNaut’ G-Shock GMC-2500 GAC-2500 Series: Price, Specs, Availability
summary: In what appears to be a follow-up to the mighty “CasiOak,” the rugged Japanese watch brand is expected to release an all-new luxury homage.
llm_summary: Casio is gearing up to launch a new “CasioNaut” line—G‑Shock models GMC‑2500 and GAC‑2500—that builds on the buzz from its recent “CasiOak” tribute. The upcoming watches blend the brand’s signature rugged durability with upscale design cues, positioning them as luxury‑inspired timepieces. Pricing, detailed specs and release dates are still pending, but the launch is expected
